title: Website Maintenance Cost UK: What Small Businesses Pay in 2026
meta_title: Website Maintenance Cost UK 2026: Monthly Prices
meta_description: UK website maintenance costs £29–£200 a month for small businesses. What's included at each price, ecommerce costs, and what skipping it can cost you.
keywords: how much does website maintenance cost

faq.q: How much does website maintenance cost in the UK?
faq.a: Most UK small businesses pay £29 to £100 a month for a managed plan. Budget plans start around £20, and local agencies charge £80 to £200 a month.
Hosting, SSL, software updates, security scans, daily backups, uptime monitoring and a set number of content changes each month.

faq.q: How much does ecommerce website maintenance cost?
faq.a: Small UK online shops typically pay £99 to £250 a month because checkouts, payments and plugins need more testing.

faq.q: Can I maintain my own website?
faq.a: Yes, if you're comfortable with updates, backups and security. Budget for hosting and plugins and your own time, and have someone to call if it breaks.

faq.q: What happens if I don't maintain my website?
faq.a: Outdated software is the most common way sites get hacked. Clean-up typically costs £500 to £3,000, plus lost sales while the site is down.
